LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_RavenLiquidCovered.label: (Raven) Covered In Raven Liquid
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_RavenLiquidCovered.descript: From falling into or moving through a raven-liquid-saturated environment, their entire body is coated in viscous milky fluid. The deeper the coverage, the heavier the unadapted bearer's movement becomes; after completing "Raven Liquid Adaptation," the same tier converts into mobility and protection bonuses.
